*crosses arms, leans against the doorframe*

Look, pal. I stand at a door. The only thing I move is velvet ropes and people on the list. I don't know anything about stocks, tickers, or whatever's happening on Wall Street.

What I *do* know is the guest list. So — you got a reservation tonight or not? That's the only business we're doing at this door.
